title: DriftReport
description: Output of the Verify worker. Records drift between current repo state and the knowledge/ baseline. All detection is deterministic — no LLM calls.

verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the verify run completed

repo_sha_before.description: Repo commit SHA recorded in the last drift_baseline.yaml; empty string when no baseline exists

repo_sha_after.description: Current repo HEAD commit SHA from ScoutBundle

drift_status.description: clean: SHA unchanged, no drift possible. minor: only new capabilities found, no stale claims. major: stale claims or outdated code examples detected. new_product: no knowledge baseline exists yet.

stale_claims.description: Claims whose evidence anchors no longer hold in the current repo

reason.description: source_deleted: the evidence source_file no longer exists. evidence_changed: the file exists but the anchor text has changed.

affected_pages.description: content_path strings of live pages that used this claim

new_capabilities.description: API members, formats, or workflows present in the current repo but absent from the knowledge baseline

identifier.description: Class name, format name, or workflow label

source_file.description: File in the repo where this capability was detected

suggested_page_roles.description: Page roles where this capability is likely relevant

outdated_code_examples.description: Live content pages that contain code using imports or API calls no longer in the current api_surface

content_path.description: content_path of the affected live page

issue_type.description: outdated_import: import statement not in current allowlist. outdated_api_call: method/property not in current api_identifiers.

old_value.description: The import or API call as it appears in the content

page_drift_actions.description: Per-page action recommendation keyed by content_path. Values: no-change | enhance | update | create
